docs.title: Welcome to Phiau's Website！
docs.text:
Here you will find my study notes, research records, website maintenance updates, and more, as well as Phiau’s records of life’s little moments.

这里将会展示我的学习笔记、科研记录、网站维护等等内容，还有Phiau对生活点点滴滴的记录~

docs.title: 部署
docs.text:
mkdocs gh-deploy
但是借助Github Actions，我们可以编写脚本实现向main分支推送时，自动更新gh-pages分支。

docs.title: 其他
docs.text:
• mkdocs new [dir-name] - Create a new project.
  • mkdocs serve - Start the live-reloading docs server.
  • mkdocs build - Build the documentation site.
  • mkdocs -h - Print help message and exit.

docs.title: 碎碎念
docs.text:
1. nav、extracss、extrajavascript 里写的路径，全部相对于 docs_dir（默认 docs/），不是相对于 mkdocs.yml
  2. For full documentation visit mkdocs.org.
